doc.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01

title: Early bands: Diamond Band, Kid Rena and the Maple Leaf band
summary: Paul moves from the Diamond Band to Kid Rena's band and then the Maple Leaf band; Russell shows an old Maple Leaf card with the Gaspard name.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, late years they cut it. They changed the orchestration. Orchestration used to be put up for shell and oboe and all that stuff as time went to change. But anyway, we formed this band called Lawrence Murad and I. It was the original Diamond Band. And we had Bush Hall on the trumpet. That's the time I'd taken a wife. We weren't making much money. And then I went with Kid René's band. That was up until 1922. And I went with Kid René's band. I wanted to get me, especially Simon Murad was in the band. So I quit Kid René's band and I went with the Maple Leaf band. I've heard of the Maple Leaf. That was Willie Pajot and Willie Bontane and Oak Gasper, that bass player, Vic Gasper. Vic was on trombone.
Willamita Bontane and me, Paul, Globone, were playing sax. Now, uh... Is that the one? Yeah, this is the one.

That's the card that Ralph has here. Is that one you got from Fess? Uh-huh. Original Maple Leaf novelty jazz orchestra. Octave Gasper, manager. 1728 Marais. Music furnished for all occasions. And Victor Gasper, that's the right way to spell their name, is it G-A-S-P-A-R-D. Uh-huh. And he was on Allen Street. That's about where he lived all his life, wasn't he? That's right. 1525.
You see that, Mary? I didn't... Excuse me.
I didn't work with them long. Maybe just about three weeks or so. Yeah. And I left and I went with the Tuxedo Band.
